The '''Citadel of Ebenmal''' was an ancient citadel which was said to have never fallen to an invader in 10,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. However this distinction was brought to an end by 85 [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]], who in less than one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] [[Battle of Ebenmal|captured]] the Citadel and made the defenders, 3,000 [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], surrender.

==History==
Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Explain">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]] shows that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was founded in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. According to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]], the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' happen in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Thus, the battle happened between the two [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> the Citadel was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base and was occupied by at least 3,000 Rebels. One day an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified stratospheric freighter|stratospheric freighter]] released eighty-five prototype [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]], who floated down to the Citadel.

First the Jumptroopers hit the Comms Towers and then the rear ammo dumps, [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] supplies and [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], to prevent any escape. Whenever the Rebels tried to fight back the Jumptroopers would move higher into the [[Atmosphere|air]]. Less than an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] after the attack began the Rebels surrendered and the Empire captured the Citadel of Ebenmal.<ref name="Jumptrooper" />
